name: silu_and_mul
description: Fused gated SiLU activation with signature silu_and_mul(hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor. For a floating-point input of shape [..., 2*d] with an even last dimension, split it into x1 = hidden_states[..., :d] and x3 = hidden_states[..., d:]. Compute silu(x1.float()) * x3.float() in float32 and cast the result back to the input dtype, matching the explicit reference. Return a newly allocated tensor of shape [..., d] on the input device, without mutating or aliasing the input. The current correctness and benchmark suites exercise two-dimensional bfloat16 inputs.
